title: PerandamΨ — IllustrisTNG 100-Galaxy Calibration Sample
description: Exact 1-to-1 conversion of the 100 IllustrisTNG reference galaxies synthesized with SpecSynth & FSPS
provenance: IllustrisTNG Cosmological Simulation (TNG-100-1) + FSPS v3.2 (Chabrier IMF, MIST Isochrones)

discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Intense starburst producing 2.1 M☉/yr at z=0.49. Extreme rest-frame UV continuum with blue color [F150W - F444W] = -1.72.

hypotheses.primary: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: High): Major gas-rich disk merger triggering gravitational gas collapse and nuclear starburst (Hopkins+08, Sanders+88).
hypotheses.alternative: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: Medium): Massive cold-stream accretion feeding a compact starburst ring (Dekel+09).
hypotheses.required_observations: Missing: NIRSpec IFU or G395H spectroscopy to resolve Hα and [N II] kinematics and confirm kinematically disturbed tidal tails.

jwst_followup.science_goal: Resolve Hα velocity dispersion and [O III] / Hβ line ratios to map merger kinematics and outflows.
jwst_followup.target_acquisition: NIRSpec WATA required: Verify bright reference star (V < 20 mag) within 2 arcmin.

discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Extreme stellar mass assembly (log M* = 10.70) when the universe was only 2 Gyr old, placing it in the top 0.2% of halo masses.

hypotheses.primary: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: High): Extreme cosmological density fluctuation in a protocluster core (Overzier+16, Chiang+17).
hypotheses.alternative: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: Medium): Top-heavy initial mass function (IMF) inflating apparent stellar mass (Marks+12).
hypotheses.required_observations: Missing: NIRCam Wide-Field Slitless Grism imaging to map companion satellite density and confirm protocluster overdensity.

jwst_followup.science_goal: Map spatial distribution of companion satellite galaxies to measure cluster overdensity parameter delta.
jwst_followup.target_acquisition: NIRCam direct imaging: Module A/B pointing, no dedicated target acquisition star required.

discovery_profile.observed_phenomenon: Massive galaxy (log M* = 11.40) at z=1.57 with quenched star formation (SFR = 21.852 M☉/yr) and sharp 4000 Å break.

hypotheses.primary: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: High): Kinetic radio-mode AGN feedback expelled cold star-forming gas (Carnall+23, Valentino+20).
hypotheses.alternative: Candidate Interpretation (Confidence: Low): Environmental shock-heating preventing virial halo gas cooling (Birnboim+03).
hypotheses.required_observations: Missing: NIRSpec PRISM / CLEAR rest-frame optical spectrum to measure Hδ absorption and confirm rapid quenching < 300 Myr ago.

jwst_followup.science_goal: Detect post-starburst Balmer absorption (Hδ, Hγ) and Dn4000 break amplitude to constrain quenching epoch.
jwst_followup.target_acquisition: NIRSpec WATA required: Verify bright reference star (V < 20 mag) within 2 arcmin.
